properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Core blockchain cryptography: ECDSA over secp256k1 for every transaction signature — key generation/signing in src/key.cpp, verification in src/pubkey.cpp and the script interpreter, pubkey recovery, plus the vendored library's own ECDH/recovery modules. Changeable only at consensus level: replacing the signature curve (ML-DSA-class) is a network-wide migration requiring a soft/hard fork and re-derivation of every address — not a local code edit. Observable here, algorithm fixed by protocol. The

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Definition confirmed in src/random.cpp:73-88: insecure_rand is a first-party xorshift PRNG (insecure_rand_Rz/Rw state, seeded from the libsodium CSPRNG via seed_insecure_rand/GetRandBytes) — named "insecure" by the authors. Only live production use is src/net.h:404 (P2P address-relay slot choice); all other sites are test code. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Poly1305 tag of the ChaCha20-Poly1305 IETF AEAD protecting Zcash note plaintexts; decrypt result is consensus-verified. Quantum-safe as a MAC (poly-time secure); referenced to the AEAD entry for a single CBOM asset.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: libsecp256k1's optional ECDH module (secp256k1 scalar-mult ECDH): compiled in CI builds and benchmarked; the capability ships in the library whether or not this application calls it. Replaceable only via the vendored library's build configuration; upstream-owned algorithm.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Zcash sprout note-encryption key agreement on Curve25519 (libsodium): ephemeral X25519 scalarmult plus PRF-derived clamped viewing keys; the shared secret feeds the BLAKE2b "ZcashKDF" KDF (NoteEncryption.cpp:47) that keys the ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD. Consensus-critical — every wallet decrypts notes with it. Migration to ML-KEM-768-class KEM requires a protocol/consensus change; changeable here only at that level.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: OpenSSL ECDSA over secp256k1 as a cross-implementation oracle in libsecp256k1's test suite/benchmark — test-infrastructure use of a real Shor-vulnerable primitive; the production signature path is the libsecp256k1 code covered by ALG-673c8f24.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 (libsodium crypto_sign) authenticates every JoinSplit transaction. Production verification is consensus code at src/main.cpp:1029 (crypto_sign_verify_detached — reported as a separate finding for that location); wallet-side signing at src/wallet/rpcwallet.cpp:2837 and src/wallet/asyncrpcoperation_shieldcoinbase.cpp:196. This object's site is the unit test of the canonicality check.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 14 sites are the RFC 4231 HMAC-SHA256 test vectors in src/test/crypto_tests.cpp, exercising the first-party CHMAC_SHA256 implementation in src/crypto/hmac_sha256.cpp which is compiled into the node. Test-only use sites; the production HMAC use of the same implementation is Tor SAFECOOKIE auth (torcontrol.cpp ComputeResponse), reported as a separate finding because no inventory object covers it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 in Python developer tooling and the RPC test framework — dev/QA usage, not consensus code. The consensus-critical C++ SHA-256 (CSHA256 class, src/crypto/sha256.{h,cpp}) used for txid/PoW and the Zcash PRF/commitment/merkle operations in src/zcash is NOT in this object's site list; the src/zcash uses are reported as separate findings.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ChaCha20-Poly1305 IETF AEAD (libsodium) encrypting Zcash note plaintexts: 32-byte key from the Curve25519 ECDH → BLAKE2b "ZcashKDF" KDF, all-zero nonce justified by single-use keys. Decryption is consensus-verified; quantum-safe symmetric AE (Grover only halves strength). This is the umbrella entry; the Poly1305 object (ALG-e6238d01) references it as the same call sites.
